activity_summary: Lady Hoby had the candles off the players' floor and would not wait on the gentlemen for them. The floor was six paces by four. A screen stood at one end, and a stool for the book behind it. Marchpane and hippocras were going as you came in. Twelve had sat at table. My lord was not among them. Sir Edward asked for King Richard whole, the parliament and all, after the marchpane, and he presented you himself. Sir Robert was in the chair. You bowed and did not explain. You did not move anyone to make Gaunt's death more convenient.

facets.activity: Entered on Lady Hoby's order and bowed

quotes.speaker: margaret_hoby
quotes.text: The gentlemen may wait. The candles cannot.

quotes.speaker: margaret_hoby
quotes.text: Put the chair there, and the king may sit in it. My father's men know where to stand.

quotes.speaker: edward_hoby
quotes.text: We shall have room enough, provided no man brings his whole importance with him.

quotes.speaker: edward_hoby
quotes.text: Sir Robert dines lightly and listens hard, Master Shakespeare. Give us King Richard whole, the parliament and all, after the marchpane.

quotes.speaker: edward_hoby
quotes.text: My father-in-law's men, Sir Robert. And a king, as I promised. He will present himself to your view.

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: Six paces by four, sir, if I have paced it honest.
